promise_band.headline: A Transparent, Free Estimate Before Anything Starts
promise_band.body: Before any construction begins, we offer a transparent, free estimate so you have a clear understanding of the project's scope and costs. signature_system.intro: For the last 20 years, we've built our business on outstanding customer service, quality craftsmanship, and transparent pricing — earning a reputation as one of the most trusted roofing companies in NEPA and New Jersey.

about_block.headline: A NEPA & NJ Roofing Company Built Over 20 Years
about_block.body: Allabaugh Construction, LLC is led by owner Jared Allabaugh out of Plymouth, PA. For over 20 years, we've built a reputation for delivering exceptional roofing and construction services to clients throughout Northeast Pennsylvania — including Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, and Hazleton — as well as New Jersey communities like Princeton and Hamilton. Our full-service approach handles everything from roof repairs and replacements to siding, gutters, and skylight installation for residential and commercial properties.
about_block.photo_alt: Completed roof replacement on a two-story home at dusk

seo_body.headline: Roofing Contractors in Northeast Pennsylvania & New Jersey
paragraphs: When searching for a reliable roofing company in NJ and NEPA, homeowners need a strong, durable roof to protect their family and belongings from the elements. Allabaugh Construction, LLC's team of skilled professionals delivers top-notch repair, installation, and maintenance services, tailored to your specific requirements.

We work with both modern and traditional materials, including architectural shingles and EPDM roofing systems, to deliver durable, high-quality results — whether your property needs re-roofing, maintenance, partial or full tear-offs, or assessment after storm damage.

We proudly serve all of New Jersey, Lackawanna County, and Luzerne County, PA, offering high-quality roofing and siding solutions, and we specialize in both asphalt shingle roofs and flat roofs for homes and businesses alike.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs repair or replacement?
faqs.a: Roof inspections by a professional can help determine whether your roof requires repair or replacement. Factors such as age, visible damage, and leaks will be considered when recommending a service.

faqs.q: How long does a typical asphalt shingle roofing installation last?
faqs.a: A roof's lifespan depends on the materials used and how well it has been maintained. With that said, asphalt shingle roofs generally last 20-30 years.

faqs.q: What is the best type of roof for my home?
faqs.a: The best roof for your home depends on factors such as your budget, the local climate, and your aesthetic preferences. Our team can help you determine the best roofing option for your needs.

faqs.q: How often should I schedule roof maintenance?
faqs.a: Regular roof maintenance is crucial for prolonging the life of your roof. Having your roof inspected at least once a year or after severe weather events is generally recommended.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost?
faqs.a: The cost of a new roof can vary based on factors like the size of your roof, the roofing material chosen, and any additional services needed. Consulting with our team will provide you with an accurate, free estimate.

faqs.q: Will my new roof come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes — every roof we install comes with a lifetime Manufacturer's Warranty and a 10-Year Workmanship Warranty. Discuss the warranty details with our team today.
